summary: Short residential kerb on Central Avenue with homes 12 m away on the same side.

best_section.where: west kerb of Central Avenue, just north of the cross street

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12-13 m away on the west side, more homes across the road at 20 m or more.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars; kerbside room for a van.
drivers.convention: Cars parked along the kerb, so a van is not out of place; no signs mapped.

sun_shade: Mostly open; trees on the west side give some morning shade.
